d:
Finding a forever home isn't always easy, especially when every rescue dog deserves a family that truly understands them. From hopeful beginnings to difficult decisions, Tia Torres is determined to give these pit bulls the chance at a better life.
In Pit Bulls & Parolees, Tia and her team are working to connect rescued pit bulls with loving families. But finding the right match takes patience, understanding and a whole lot of heart. Will these dogs finally meet the people they've been waiting for?
